Detailed Description

Contains properties and functions used to implement fixed coefficient multiplication.

Parameters
nbitsthe nbits used for the summation and storing the coefficients
coeffsan array of TwoCmplt structs for storing k*coeff, k = 0,..,15
shiftsan array of tuples used for shifting coeffs depending on which nibble
bitsan array of tuples used in selecting the nibbles from the signal
nibblesthe nibble values, included for clarity but not really needed
readya Bool value to indicate a set of coeffs has been loaded
synca Bool that is high once each 16 signal values that can be used for synchronizing the updating of the coefficients. The input to the uploading block is changed when sync just goes to false
kthe indic used in the coefficient update block
